title: Sign-valued Maiorana–McFarland function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $g$ assign a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ to each vector in $\mathbb F_2^n$. The function on $\mathbb F_2^{2n}$ that splits an input into blocks $(x,y)$ and takes the product of $(-1)^{x\cdot y}$ with $g(y)$ has absolute value $1$ at every input.
